name: Haldor
title: Vendor of Fine Goods
location: Black Forest, within 1500m of world center. Look for the bag icon on the map.
tip: Build a portal next to him immediately. His camp has a runic dome — no enemies can enter. His Lox is called Halstein.

sells.name: Fishing Rod
sells.desc: Required to catch fish. Essential purchase early game.

sells.name: Fishing Bait (x50)
sells.desc: Common bait for rivers and lakes. Buy stacks of these regularly.

sells.name: Dverger Circlet
sells.desc: A helmet acting as a permanent hands-free light source. Essential for caves and crypts.

sells.name: Megingjord
sells.desc: Belt that increases carry weight by 150. The only way to increase inventory capacity.

sells.name: Yule Hat
sells.desc: A festive red cap. Pure cosmetic — no armor value.

sells.name: Barber Kit
sells.desc: Lets you change your character's hair and beard style at any time.

sells.name: Ymir Flesh
sells.desc: Rare crafting material only available here. Needed for Frostner and Iron Sledge.
sells.unlockTip: Defeat The Elder (Black Forest boss) to unlock

sells.name: Thunder Stone
sells.desc: Needed to build the Obliterator, which destroys unwanted items and returns coal.
sells.unlockTip: Defeat The Elder (Black Forest boss) to unlock

sells.name: Barrel Hoops
sells.desc: Metal rings needed to build Barrels for storing liquids.

sells.name: Chicken Egg
sells.desc: Place near a fire for 30 min to hatch a hen. Two hens will keep producing eggs. Required for chicken-based foods.

name: Hildir
title: Haldor's Sister — Clothing Merchant
location: Meadows, 3000–5100m from world center. Harder to find than Haldor — expect to sail.
tip: Most items are cosmetic but the Harvest set gives real bonuses. Complete her quests by returning 3 stolen chests — they can't be teleported, you must carry them by boat.

sells.name: Iron Cooking Station
sells.desc: A better cooking station than the standard one. Holds more slots and handles more advanced recipes.

sells.name: Wrist Fireworks (Sparklers)
sells.desc: Cosmetic sparkler item for celebrations.

sells.name: Simple Dress / Tunic (3 colors)
sells.desc: Basic clothing — brown, blue, yellow. 1 armor. +0 stats.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Brass Chest — defeat Brenna in the Smouldering Tombs (Black Forest)

sells.name: Harvest Tunic / Harvest Dress
sells.desc: Farming outfit. -20% stamina use while farming. +25 Farming skill. Real gameplay value!
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Brass Chest — defeat Brenna in the Smouldering Tombs (Black Forest)

sells.name: Straw Hat
sells.desc: Part of the Harvest set. Pairs with Harvest Tunic/Dress for the farming bonuses.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Brass Chest — defeat Brenna in the Smouldering Tombs (Black Forest)

sells.name: Tied Headscarf (yellow)
sells.desc: Cosmetic headscarf. 1 armor.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Brass Chest — defeat Brenna in the Smouldering Tombs (Black Forest)

sells.name: Shawl Dress / Cape Tunic (3 colors)
sells.desc: Mid-tier clothing with shawl or cape. 1 armor. Brown, blue, yellow.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Silver Chest — defeat Geirrhafa in the Howling Caverns (Mountain)

sells.name: Twisted Headscarf (green), Extravagant Cap (green), Tied Headscarf (yellow)
sells.desc: Cosmetic headwear — 3 styles.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Silver Chest — defeat Geirrhafa in the Howling Caverns (Mountain)

sells.name: Beaded Dress / Beaded Tunic (3 colors)
sells.desc: Fancy clothing with bead accessories. 1 armor. Brown, blue, yellow.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Bronze Chest — defeat Zil in the Sealed Tower (Plains)

sells.name: Twisted Headscarf (red), Fur Cap (grey), Extravagant Cap (orange)
sells.desc: Cosmetic headwear — 3 more styles.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Bronze Chest — defeat Zil in the Sealed Tower (Plains)

sells.name: Basic Fireworks
sells.desc: Fireworks rocket for celebrations. Pure cosmetic.
sells.unlockTip: Return Hildir's Bronze Chest — defeat Zil in the Sealed Tower (Plains)

name: Bog Witch
title: Greydwarf Trader — Magical Ingredients
location: Swamp, 3000–8000m from world center. The hardest vendor to find — build a portal immediately.
tip: A friendly Greydwarf in a clean hut. She sells rare ingredients required for Feast recipes and special meads. Her Kvastur pet keeps the hut clean.

sells.name: Serving Tray (Feaster)
sells.desc: Required to set up a Feast table. Feasts give powerful shared buffs to all nearby players.

sells.name: Ivy Seeds (x3)
sells.desc: Plant with cultivator to grow decorative ivy for building.

sells.name: Candle Wick
sells.desc: Used to craft various candles for building decoration.

sells.name: Corked Vial
sells.desc: Used to craft Blob Bombs (poison, frost, lava, tar variants). Handle with care.

sells.name: Scythe Handle
sells.desc: Required to craft the Scythe weapon at a forge.

sells.name: Love Potion (x5)
sells.desc: Increases troll spawn rate and chance of starred trolls. Great for farming troll hide.

sells.name: Mead Base: Berserkir
sells.desc: Ferment to make Berserkir Mead — a powerful rage-inducing combat buff.

sells.name: Mead Base: Ratatosk
sells.desc: Ferment for a speed-boosting mead named after the squirrel on Yggdrasil.

sells.name: Mead Base: Animal Whispers
sells.desc: Ferment for a taming mead — makes taming animals significantly easier.

sells.name: Mead Base: Lightfoot
sells.desc: Ferment for reduced footstep noise. Useful for sneaking past or around enemies.

sells.name: Mead Base: Anti-Sting
sells.desc: Ferment for bug repellent mead — reduces damage from Deathsquitos and Seekers.

sells.name: Mead Base: Troll Endurance
sells.desc: Ferment for a carry weight boost. Situational alternative to Megingjord.

sells.name: Mead Base: Vananidir
sells.desc: Ferment for swimming speed and stamina boost.

sells.name: Pungent Pebbles (x5)
sells.desc: Smelly ingredient used in Fiery Svinstew and Ashlands-tier food recipes.

sells.name: Fragrant Bundle (x5)
sells.desc: Aromatic plants used in high-tier food. Also reduces bug/insect enemy aggro.

sells.name: Herbs of the Hidden Hills
sells.desc: Rare herbs for Mistlands and Ashlands tier cooking recipes.
sells.unlockTip: Defeat The Queen (Mistlands boss) to unlock
